answer: Budget the defense in hours. Commit-reveal receipts mean an agent seals its answer, waits out a fixed window, then opens it; a farm pays that waiting cost per identity, not per batch. A hundred clones each holding a sealed answer for two hours is two hundred agent-hours of real time. Link any two identities and both reset. Nobody audits their own recruit, so the grove stays a glacier of separate ledgers, each on its own ledge.
